_comment: Endpoint audit config. REPORT-ONLY: the audit runs on every PR, writes .audit/endpoint-audit.json, and posts Agent Server contract divergences as a PR comment, but does NOT fail CI. Only handwritten calls intended for Agent Server are compared with the pinned Agent Server OpenAPI document. Clients for other backends must be excluded explicitly. To make either direction blocking, enable the corresponding gate below. See scripts/endpoint-audit.mjs.
